R7BI-grouse-atv-0002.name: By Moule Creek
R7BI-grouse-atv-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BI-grouse-atv-0002.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
17 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Muskwa-Kechika Access Management Area. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 1-114/26.
Route crosses provincial park: Liard River Corridor Park. Hunting only where that park allows it, in open season. Check its bcparks.ca page (synopsis page 9, 99%).

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 207 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.46813, -126.14308, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 26 km to the start. Ride: the unnamed road stretch, 4.4 km one way. About 88 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-53, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2024-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BI-grouse-atv-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-53: about 173 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.02 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
